(NYSE:JILL) (“J.Jill” or the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on October 7, 2026 to stockholders of record of issued and outstanding shares of the Company's common stock as of September 23, 2026. About J.Jill, Inc. J.Jill is a national lifestyle brand that provides apparel, footwear and accessories designed to help its customers move through a full life with ease. The brand represents an easy, thoughtful and inspired style that celebrates the totality of all women and designs its products with its core brand ethos in mind: keep it simple and make it matter. J.Jill offers a high touch customer experience through about 250 stores nationwide and a robust ecommerce platform. J.Jill is headquartered outside Boston. For more information, please visit www.jjill.com or http://investors.jjill.com . The information included on our websites is not incorporated by reference herein.
